subject: How can I capture the node label or value at runtime for bubbles chart using bubble::renderBubbles

messages.author: f6e92ac44637af80
messages.subject: How can I capture the node label or value at runtime for bubbles chart using bubble::renderBubbles
parts:
I am creating bubble plot using library(bubbles) in r and shiny.

I get the plot but my requirement is I should be able to capture the value in each node when user clicks so that I can create my next plot based on this input.

How can I plugin the javascript to get the desired output.

 

Appreciate any help on this.

 

ui.R

 

bubblesOutput("Plot", width = "100%", height = 600)

 

server.R

 

output$Plot <- renderBubbles({

 

    df <- datadf[,c("A","B")]

    df$B<-as.numeric(df$B)

    bubbles(value=df$B, label=df$A, key = df$A,color = rainbow(length(count), alpha=NULL))

  })

messages.subject: Re: How can I capture the node label or value at runtime for bubbles chart using bubble::renderBubbles
parts:
Do you have JavaScript/d3 experience? If so, you can try forking bubbles and modifying this file:
https://github.com/jcheng5/bubbles/blob/master/inst/htmlwidgets/bubbles.js

You'd have to add a click event for the bubbles, and upon click, call Shiny.onInputChange(chartId + "_click", value) or something like that.
